name: hidx_op_pr2-idxopq1405-COMMIT
purpose: idx_op successor of hidx_op_pr (gate WARN util 5%, TT ins 412.5/spread 92.8, rst_n 4,708 loads, 5 runtime part-selects): same ports and data timing; rst_n -> ot_rst_relay (2 regions, ~100 reset loads), reset-free data flops (vm_static DRST=0), decoded constant-index slices; outline 216 x 108 = pin-bound minimum (S face 2,192 pins x 0.096 um = 210.4 um, E face 1,092 pins = 104.8 um) inside the v8 idx_op slot origin (H-DIE grant idx_soft_parent_grant_1016 idx_op_outline); clk/rst_n on the N face centre. Benches run_vm_query.sh (MUT0 pass, MUT1-3 fail) + run_scheduled.sh.

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_hbm_idx_vm_query_static u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/hbm_accel/index/ot_hbm_idx_vm_query_static.sv rtl/hbm_accel/index/ot_hbm_idx_vm_static.sv rtl/lib/ot_rst_relay.sv && echo lint-ok

bench.name: vm_query_exact
bench.pass_regex: IDX_VM_QUERY_STATIC MUT0 commits514 reads514 blocks128 quant32 errors0 fault0

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/hidx_op_pr2/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/hidx_op_pr2/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/hidx_op_pr2 --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_hbm_idx_vm_query_static  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1
